einzeiler: Exploring new global releases, from Chilean jazz-soul to heavy metal in Guadalajara.
kurzfassung: Felix Contreras and Ana Maria Sayer present a diverse roundup of new global music releases spanning Latin America and beyond. The episode features recent albums and tracks from artists like Cultura Profética, Claudia Acuña, and Ladrones. The hosts explore how contemporary musicians blend traditional sounds with modern genres like jazz, folk, and metal.
stichpunkte: Discussion of Rosalia's recent high-energy, performance-art-style concert run in Mexico City
Cultura Profética's new album En Bucle and their collaboration with artist Capo on the track Flaca
Claudia Acuña's album Ave de Luz, blending Chilean jazz, soul, and indigenous instrumentation
Mari Froes's debut album Esquina do Sol, featuring an R&B torch ballad and jazzy arrangements
Valeria Stewart's album On a Wing, drawing on her Argentine background with American folk and blues elements
Raquel Diamantas's album Cosmo Dorme, characterized by a soft 1970s pop vibe and dedicated to her baby
Ladrones from Guadalajara combining regional Mexican music aesthetics with death metal

clips.hook: A slowed-down Afrobeats mixed with a sped-up reggae
clips.text: The hosts analyze a musical collaboration that merges reggae elements with contemporary Latin Afrobeats, creating a unique cross-genre sound.

clips.hook: Standard jazz instrumentation paired with traditional Chilean folk instruments
clips.text: An overview of an artist's eclectic setup highlights the combination of standard jazz instruments alongside an accordion, charango, and flute.

clips.hook: The lifelong question of artistic identity and staying in your lane
clips.text: A host reflects on the challenges of artistic growth, questioning whether musicians should stick to a familiar style or expand into new territory.

clips.hook: An album crafted during pregnancy and named after a sleeping baby
clips.text: The background of a Brazilian indie record reveals that the creator worked on the material while pregnant, inspiring a collection dedicated to her child.

clips.hook: Where fast regional Mexican guitar picking meets intense death metal
clips.text: The hosts break down how the rapid finger-picking techniques found in modern regional Mexican tunes translate naturally into the aggression of heavy metal.

beschreibung:
I like to think I’m the one who keeps things fresh on the show — or at least that’s what I tell everyone. But this week Felix once again proved that false, bringing in a fresh corridos tumbados duo from Guadalajara who takes a something-old-turned-new genre and smashes it together with metal. It's something I’ve never heard before. What can I say, Felix keeps us all young. I went back to Brazil with some up-and-coming artists whose albums I’ve been excitedly awaiting. And, of course, Felix had to balance things out with one of his favorite jazz vocalists. As per usual, we’re all about whiplash here at Alt.Latino, but in a way that hopefully will make you the favorite DJ at your next fiesta. — Ana
